# Jag Art House

> Official portfolio and professional profile for Jag 'Arthouse' Manalang, a cinematographer with roots in the Bay Area and a growing presence in Los Angeles. Based in both, he creates atmospheric films across narrative, commercial, documentary, and music video work.

## Person

- Name: Jag 'Arthouse' Manalang
- Professional name: Jag Manalang
- Studio/portfolio name: Jag Art House
- Primary role: Cinematographer
- Additional roles: 1st AC, camera operator, drone pilot
- Base: Bay Area and Los Angeles, California
- Style: Atmospheric, humanistic, personal, and technically fluid visual storytelling
- Portfolio history: 50+ releases across Instagram, YouTube, and Vimeo; work with 5+ clients; two music videos; and promotional films for an independent barber that helped drive a substantial increase in viewership

## Capabilities and gear

- Camera and lighting: technical command from prep through execution
- Sony: FX3, FX6, FX9
- RED: Komodo
- DJI: Ronin 4D, Mini 3, Mini 4K, RS gimbals
- Stabilization: Steadicam

## Selected filmography

- DIASPORA — Short film about displacement, identity, and personal heritage.
- NOCTURNAL — Visual art exploring urban nightlife, high-contrast shadows, and neon aesthetics.
- PINKWALL — Music video and fashion film built around youthful energy and pastel color.
- KILLER SERVE — Commercial sports film capturing athletic precision, training grit, and intense movement.
- BIGGER PROBLEMS — Narrative music video with intimate performances and cinematic lighting.
- HALLOWEEKEND — Event aftermovie capturing nightlife energy and stylized transitions.
- MAGNOLIA — Commercial narrative focused on natural lighting, organic environments, and human connection.
- NEW NUISANCE — Experimental short film about modern urban isolation.
- BAD — Stylized music video with choreography and dynamic tracking shots.
- DOWN IN LA — Visual poem shaped by Los Angeles streets, architecture, and golden light.
- SANTA SUSANA — Narrative drama set against desert canyon landscapes.
- HEIGHTS of MARINA — Commercial architectural film featuring modern interiors and fluid camera movement.
- OLDIES BUT GOLDIES — Visual art piece inspired by vintage film stocks and nostalgic compositions.
- SIMILIS — Science-fiction short examining symmetry, reflection, and human interaction.
- YALA Spec Ad — Lifestyle product spec advertisement with bold visual contrast.
- CALL ME WHEN YOU CAN — Narrative thriller centered on isolation and a telephone call.
- YERBA ISLE — Coastal visual poem with tranquil natural compositions.
- SAY, DELILAH — Romance-inspired music video with soft lighting and emotional storytelling.
- JAY SOMBER of WHITHER — Documentary portrait focused on an artist's creative process.
- LOVE STORY ON THE PIER — Golden-hour romantic visual narrative.
- 30 PERCENT — Minimalist commercial short with stark contrast.
